parole.testo: From Proto-Slavic *děľa (“because of”). Cognate with Lithuanian dė̃l.

parole.significato: a Russian, a Russian man, a man from Russia or of Russian descent
parole.testo: From earlier *kreiv-, from a Slavic stem *kriv-, from Proto-Slavic *krȋvъ, from Proto-Balto-Slavic *kréiwas, which has the same source as Latvian krèiss (“left”) (q.v.). Uncertain. Possibly from or related to Proto-Slavic *němъ; see there for theories.
